settings.updates.about.text: I-CadCraft Studio ivela ku-The Data Design Group, Inc. (getcadcraft.com): ama-app e-CAD ne-BIM ayisishiyagalombili amahhala, avulekile umthombo, ekufakweni eyodwa. Ezinye izinkampani zinamagama afanayo; asihlanganiswe nazo.
settings.title: Izilungiselelo
help.title: Usizo
help.start.title: I-Studio ukuthini
help.start.body: I-Studio iyisikrini sasekhaya se-ama-apps ayisishiyagalombili e-CadCraft. Ivula i-app ngayinye, igcina amafayela akho asanda kusuka kuzo zonke endaweni eyodwa, futhi ivula noma yiliphi ifayela ku-app elilifundayo. Akuyona i-app yesishiyagalolunye: yonke i-app isebenza nayo yodwa.
help.open.title: Ukuvula amafayela
help.open.body: Khetha Vula ifayela noma ulahle amafayela ku-Studio. Imidwebo iya ku-CadCraft, amamodeli ku-BimCraft kanti okunye kuya ku-app elikufundayo. I-PDF ingabukwa ku-MarkupCraft noma ilinganiswe ku-TakeoffCraft, ngakho i-Studio iyabuza, futhi ingakhumbula impendulo yakho (Izilungiselelo, Ukuvula amafayela).
help.recent.title: Amafayela asanda kusetshenziswa
help.recent.body: Yonke ifayela ovula noma olondoloza kunoma iyiphi i-app libhalwe lapha, elisha kakhulu kuqala. Chofoza elilodwa ukuze uliyivule ku-app elivela kuyo. Kwisiphequluli, izisphequluli ezikhumbula amafayela kuphela (i-Chrome ne-Edge) ezingawavula zodwa.
help.windows.title: Amawindi
help.windows.body: Ifayela ngalinye livula kwiwindi layo, ukuze ube nemidwebo eminingi evulekile ecaleni komunye nomunye. Inkinobho ye-Studio kubha ye-app ngayinye ikubuyisela lapha.
help.account.title: I-akhawunti yakho nemidwebo ye-cloud
help.account.body: Ngena kanye bese yonke i-app ingavula futhi ilondoloze imidwebo yakho ye-cloud. I-Studio ibonisa ikhodi emfushane; yivume ku-getcadcraft.com/device. Uma ungaphandle kwe-inthanethi, izilondolozo zilindela kule khompyutha bese zithunyelwa uxhumano lubuya; ukulondoloza akusoze kubhale phezu kwenguqulo entsha.
help.assistants.title: Ukuxhuma umsizi
help.assistants.body: Umsizi we-AI angasebenza emidwebeni yakho nge-Studio (ideskithophu). Vula i-app, uvule Izilungiselelo › Abasizi lapho bese ukhetha okuvunyelwe ukukwenza. Ikhadi elithi Xhuma umsizi lizobonisa ikheli elisebenza kule khompyutha kuphela, ithokheni, nezilungiselelo okufanele uzinamathisele kumsizi wakho. Gcina ithokheni iyimfihlo. Ithokheni entsha iphuma kubo bonke abasizi; Nqamula konke iphelisa iseshini zabo zonke.
help.offline.title: Ukusebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi
help.offline.body: I-Studio nama-apps asebenza kwikhompyutha yakho. Akukho okuvulwayo okulayishwa uma ungakulondolozi ku-cloud.
help.updates.title: Ukufaka nokubuyekeza
help.updates.body: Thola i-Studio ohlelweni lwakho ku-getcadcraft.com/download. Izilungiselelo › Izibuyekezo zibonisa inguqulo yakho nohlobo lwayo, lapho izibuyekezo zivela khona, nokuthi i-Studio ihlole nini okokugcina, kanye nenguqulo entsha kakhulu yohlobo lwakho nokusha kwayo. Hlola izibuyekezo ifuna inguqulo entsha futhi njalo ibuza ngaphambi kokufaka noma yini; "Hlola ngokuzenzakalelayo" ivulekile ekuqaleni futhi ihlola kanye ngosuku; yivale uma uthanda, futhi isibuyekezo sifakwa kuphela uma sinesiqinisekiso se-CadCraft. Umfakeli we-Windows, i-Linux .deb ne-AppImage zibuyekezwa ku-getcadcraft.com; i-zip ephathekayo ikutshela kuphela uma i-zip entsha itholakele (yilande bese uhambisa ifolda yakho yedatha kuyo). Iphakheji ye-Windows evela ku-getcadcraft.com ibuyekezwa nge-Windows App Installer, nekhophi yesitolo se-Microsoft ngesitolo sayo; Hlola izibuyekezo ze-Studio icela i-Windows zombili. Izinhlelo ezivela kwezinye izitolo (App Store, Google Play) zibuyekezwa ngalezo zitolo. Ikhophi yesiphequluli ibuyekezwa ngokubeka ukulanda okusha esikhundleni sesikhwama sayo. Uma ukukhishwa okusha kakhulu kungenayo ifayela lohlelo lwakho, ukuhlola kuyakutshela lokho kunokuthi kwehlulekile. Ku-Linux, i-Studio icima indlela yegrafikhi engase ishiye iwindi limnyama kwamanye amadivayisi; i-WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER oyisethe wena uyishiywa njengoba uyisethile.

help.live.title: Live TeamWork
help.live.body: Vula ifayela kunoma iyiphi i-app bese ukhetha Live kwibha yayo, bese Yabelana. Abantu abaku-inethiwekhi efanayo bajoyina ngekhodi eboniswa yi-Studio (noma ngokuskena isithombe); kwabanye abaphi nje, yenza isixhumanisi sokumemela. Uvumela ngamunye umuntu, njengo-Hlela noma Ukubuka kuphela. Wonke umuntu ubona izinguquko njengoba zenzeka, futhi izinguquko zakho azilindi abanye. Hlehlisa kuhlehlisa imisebenzi yakho kuphela. Umphathi kuphela ulondoloza ifayela; lapho iseshini iphela, abanye bonke bagcina ikhophi engalondoloziwe. Iseshini kwinethiwekhi yakho mahhala; izixhumanisi zokumemela ku-inthanethi zidinga ilayisense yokuthengisa ye-app, kanti izihambeli azidingi lutho. Ukuze ujoyine, sebenzisa Joyina iseshini lapha.

window.live.link.noshell: Le Studio ayikwazi ukwenza izixhumanisi zokumemela. Iseshini kwinethiwekhi yakho iyasebenza.
window.live.link.offline: I-getcadcraft.com ayifinyeleleki, ngakho asikho isixhumanisi esenziwe. Iseshini kwinethiwekhi yakho isasebenza.
window.live.link.refused: I-getcadcraft.com ayivulanga igumbi lalesi sixhumanisi. Iseshini kwinethiwekhi yakho isasebenza.
window.live.link.relayfailed: I-Studio ayikwazanga ukufinyelela isiphakeli, ngakho isixhumanisi singeke sisebenze. Zama futhi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
window.live.link.gone.used: Isixhumanisi sesikhathi esisodwa sisetshenzisiwe. Yenza esisha womuntu olandelayo.
window.live.relay.reconnecting: Isixhumanisi silahlekelwe uxhumo; i-Studio iyaxhuma kabusha. Abantu abangene nge-inthanethi bayabuya ngokwabo.
window.live.relay.nolicense: Ilayisense yokuthengisa yale app ayisasebenzi. Wonke umuntu useshinini uyahlala kuze kuphele, kodwa akukwazi ukwenziwa isixhumanisi esisha.
window.live.relay.closed: Isixhumanisi siphelile. Abantu kule nethiwekhi bayahlala bexhunyiwe.
window.live.handover.title: Dlulisela iseshini: {name}
window.live.handover.ask: Dlulisela iseshini kumuntu: {name}? I-Studio yakhe iba ngumphathi futhi igcina wonke umuntu ngaphakathi; wena uhlala njengomhleli. Amakhodi asasebenza ahamba nayo. Isixhumanisi sakho sokumemela siyaphela; {name} wenza esisha uma ekwazi.
window.live.handover.moved: Iseshini ishintshele ku-Studio yomuntu {name}. Manje ungumhleli: {name} ungumphathi futhi ulondoloza ifayela kusukela manje. Ikhophi yakho yefayela ihlala ivulekile lapha.
window.live.handover.youhost: {name} udlulisele iseshini kuwe: i-Studio yakho manje ingumphathi. Londoloza ifayela lapha ukuze ugcine umsebenzi weseshini.
window.live.handover.off.unknown: {name} akakwazi ukuthatha iseshini (ungumhleli okuseshini kuphela ongakwenza lokho). Usaseyisiphathi.
window.live.handover.off.start: I-Studio yomuntu {name} ayikwazanga ukuqala iseshini. Usaseyisiphathi.
window.live.moved.follow: Umphathi udlulisele iseshini kumuntu: {name}. I-Studio iyakuyisa khona.
window.live.code.carried: Le khodi ifike neseshini kumphathi wangaphambilini futhi isasebenza.
window.live.end.moved: Iseshini ishintshele ku-Studio yomuntu: {host}, engafinyeleleki kulapha. Le windi igcina ikhophi yefayela: {file}, engalondolozwanga. Cela isixhumanisi esisha noma ikhodi kumuntu: {host}.
window.live.people.remove.ask: Susa {name} eseshinini? Bagcina ikhophi yalokho ababenakho.
window.live.edits.title: Izinguquko zakamuva
window.live.edits.gap: Ezinye izinguquko zifike lapho ungekho futhi azikhonjiwe.
window.live.edits.before: Izinguquko ezenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi ujoyine azikhonjiwe.
window.live.edits.selected.none: Okukhethiwe: akushintshwanga kule seshini selokhu le windi ijoyine.
window.live.edits.privacy: Lolu hlu lwenziwa kule windi kusuka ezinguqukweni zeseshini futhi luyanyamalala uma iseshini iphela. Alulondolozwa efayelini noma luthunyelwe noma kuphi. Wonke umuntu useshinini angabona ukuthi ubani owenze ngayinye inguquko.
window.live.flood: Uthumela izinguquko ngokushesha kunalokho iseshini engakwazi ukukuthatha. Yehlisa isivinini okwesikhashana.
window.live.refused.role: Ubuka kuphela, ngakho inguquko yakho ibuyiselwe emuva.
window.live.refused.schema: Inguqulo ye-app yakho ayikwazi ukwenza lokho kule seshini.
window.live.refused.flood: Ibuyiselwe emuva: izinguquko eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
window.live.end.ask: Phelisa iseshini kubo bonke? Ngamunye umuntu ugcina ikhophi yefayela njengalokhu linjalo manje.
window.live.end.hint: Ukuphela kushiya abanye bonke nekhophi engalondoloziwe. Ifayela lakho lilondolozwa kuphela uma ulilondoloza.
window.live.leave.hint: Ukuhamba kugcina lokho okubonayo njengekhophi engalondoloziwe kule windi.
window.live.end.copy: Iseshini iphelile. Le windi igcina ikhophi yefayela: {file} evela kumuntu: {host}, engalondolozwanga. Lilondoloze uma ufuna ukuligcina.
window.live.end.copy.nohost: Iseshini iphelile. Le windi igcina ikhophi, engalondolozwanga. Lilondoloze uma ufuna ukuligcina.
window.live.end.lost: Uxhumo nomuntu: {host} lulahlekile isikhathi eside kakhulu ukuze kulandelwe. Le windi igcina ikhophi yefayela: {file}, engalondolozwanga.
window.live.end.removed: Umuntu: {host} ukususile eseshinini. Le windi igcina ikhophi, engalondolozwanga.
window.live.end.flood: Iseshini ikususile ngoba izinguquko eziningi zifike ngesikhathi esisodwa. Le windi igcina ikhophi, engalondolozwanga.
window.live.end.wrongcode: Leyo khodi ayisebenzanga. Yihlole nomphathi; amakhodi aphelelwa yisikhathi ngemizuzu engu-10.
window.live.end.unknowncode: Akukho seshini ephendule ngalelo khodi. Yihlole nomphathi.
window.live.end.full: Abantu abaningi bengene ngalesi sixhumanisi sokumemela. Cela umphathi enye indlela yokungena.
window.live.end.roomclosed: Lesi sixhumanisi sokumemela siphelile. Cela umphathi esisha.
window.live.end.stale: Lesi sicelo sokujoyina sidala kakhulu. Qala kabusha esikrinini sokuqala se-Studio.
window.live.end.noadapter: Le app ayikwazi ukujoyina iseshini ephilayo okwamanje.
window.live.end.denied.app: Leyo seshini ikwesinye i-app. Joyina kusuka esikrinini sokuqala se-Studio, lapho kuvula eyifanele.
window.live.end.denied.schema: Leyo seshini isebenzisa inguqulo entsha yale app. Buyekeza i-Studio ukuze uyijoyine.
window.live.end.denied.full: Umphathi ugcina le seshini incane okwamanje. Cela ukuthi akuvumele ungene kamuva.
window.live.end.denied.protocol: Leyo seshini isebenzisa inguqulo entsha ye-Studio. Buyekeza i-Studio ukuze uyijoyine.
window.live.end.denied.resume: Ayikwazanga ukubuyela. Cela umphathi akumemele futhi.
window.live.apart: I-Studio ayikwazi ukufinyelela umphathi. Le nethiwekhi ingase igcine amadivayisi ehlukene (kuvame ku-Wi-Fi yezihambeli, yehhotela nezikole). Cela umphathi isixhumanisi sokumemela esikhundleni salokho; i-Studio iyaqhubeka nokuzama.
window.live.unreachable.link: I-Studio ayikwazi ukufinyelela iseshini nge-inthanethi njengamanje. Iyaqhubeka nokuzama; hlola uxhumo lwale kompyutha.
news.offline: Ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: lezi yizinsizakalo i-Studio ezithole {when}.
news.offline.none: Azikho izindaba okwamanje: i-Studio izozama futhi lapho le kompyutha ixhunywe.
settings.news.label: Thola izindaba ku-getcadcraft.com
settings.news.hint: Kanye ngosuku, i-Studio icela ku-getcadcraft.com izinsizakalo zayo zakamuva kanye nenguqulo entsha kakhulu. Ayithumeli lutho ngawe noma ngamafayela akho, futhi ayikaze ilande lutho ngokwayo.
news.dismissed: Okusha kufihliwe kuze kube kukhona okusha kakhulu. Izilungiselelo › Izindaba zikubuyisa.
settings.live.hint: Yonke i-app isebenzisa lokhu uma wenza isixhumanisi sokumemela. Usengakushintsha kwesisodwa esixhumanisweni ngaphansi kwezinketho zesixhumanisi.
account.links.hint: Lezi zivula i-getcadcraft.com kubhrawuza yakho. Uma ibhrawuza ingene njengomunye umuntu, ikhasi liyakusho. Lapha, i-Studio ifunda i-akhawunti yakho futhi.
window.live.here.title: Joyina nomdwebo uvulekile lapha
window.live.here.hint: Uvule ifayela elifanayo nomphathi? Joyina kule windi: kuhamba kuphela izinguquko kusukela ekujoyineni. Uma umdwebo womphathi ungowehlukile, uyawushintsha lapha (ifayela lakho lihlala njalo).
window.live.here.label: Ikhodi, ikheli noma isixhumanisi sokumemela
window.live.here.bad: Lokho akuyona ikhodi, ikheli elinekhodi, noma isixhumanisi sokumemela.
window.live.here.notfound: Akukho seshini enale khodi kule nethiwekhi. Hlola ikhodi, noma thayipha ikheli lomphathi nekhodi.
window.live.here.otherapp: Leyo seshini ikwesinye i-app. Yijoyine kusuka esikrinini sokuqala se-Studio.
window.live.here.nostudio: Amakhodi namakheli asebenza ku-CadCraft Studio. Kubhrawuza, vula isixhumanisi somphathi.
window.live.assistant.knock.hint: Uhlela njengomuntu {name}, nokuhlehlisa kwayo okuzimele. Mvumele kuphela uma {name} ekucelile.
window.live.assistant.waiting: Umsizi wakho ulindele umphathi ukuthi amvumele angene. Okwenziwa yiyo ngalesi sikhathi kuzongenela lapho umphathi emvumela.
window.live.assistant.denied: Umphathi akamvumelanga umsizi wakho ukuthi angene. Usuxhunywe kulo windi, futhi okwenziwe yiyo kuthathelwe emuva.
window.live.assistant.removed: Umphathi umkhiphe eseshinini umsizi wakho. Usuxhunywe kulo windi.
window.live.assistant.went: Umsizi wakho uphume neseshini nawe. Usuxhunywe kulo windi.
window.live.assistant.scope.title: Lapho usebenza khona
window.live.assistant.scope.advisory: Lolu hlelo alukwazi ukutshela ukuthi ushintsho lufika kuphi, ngakho ishidi noma indawo ayikwazi ukugcinwa.
window.live.assistant.scope.nohere: Akukho shidi noma indawo ebonakalayo okungamnika yona.
window.live.refused.scope-sheet: Thathelwe emuva: lokho akukho kushidi elinikezwe umsizi wakho.
window.live.refused.scope-area: Thathelwe emuva: lokho kungaphandle kwendawo enikezwe umsizi wakho.
window.live.refused.scope-unknown: Thathelwe emuva: uhlelo alukwazanga ukutshela ukuthi lolo shintsho lukuphi, futhi umsizi wakho unikezwe ishidi noma indawo.
window.live.link.store: Lolu hlobo lunikeza iseshini kunethiwekhi yakho kuphela: izixhumanisi zokumemezela zidinga ukungena ngemvume ku-getcadcraft.com, okungekho kulolu hlobo.
settings.input.hint: Zonke izinhlelo zivula ngesitayela esihambisana nazo, nezinguquko owenze kuleyo nhlelo; uhlelo olungenaso lugcina okwalo. Izilungiselelo › Imenyu, okhiye nembewu kuzo zonke izinhlelo ishintsha leyo nhlelo kuphela.
settings.input.on: Zonke izinhlelo manje zisebenzisa lesi sitayela: {style}.
settings.layout.reset: Setha kabusha ukwakheka kuzo zonke izinhlelo
settings.layout.hint: Uma ibha yamathuluzi, imenyu noma iphaneli silahlekile: ibha yamathuluzi, amaphaneli, imodi yesikrini nesitayela semenyu zazo zonke izinhlelo ziphindela njengoba uhlelo luqala. Amawindi avulekile alandela ngokushesha. Izindikimba, izilimi, usayizi nezilungiselelo zohlelo ngalunye zihlala.
settings.layout.confirm: Ukuhleleka kwebha yamathuluzi, amaphaneli, imodi yesikrini nesitayela semenyu zazo zonke izinhlelo kuphindela njengoba kuqala. Izitayela zemenyu owenze zihlala kuhlu lwalolo hlelo ngalinye.
settings.layout.done: Ukwakheka kwazo zonke izinhlelo kuphindele njengoba kuqala.
settings.ui.hint: Lo windi, mkhulu noma mncane. Uhlelo ngalunye lunosayizi walo: Izilungiselelo › Okuvamile › Usayizi wesixhumanisi kuhlelo.
settings.legal.operator: I-CadCraft™ yinsizakalo ye-The Data Design Group, Inc.
settings.legal.trademarks: I-CadCraft nelogo ye-CadCraft ngamagama ophawu lwentengiselwano e-The Data Design Group, Inc. Amanye amagama enkampani nomkhiqizo akhona ku-Studio nasezinhlelweni zayo, njengamagama ezinhlobo zamafayela nezinhlelo ezizenzayo, angamagama ophawu lwentengiselwano noma ophawu olubhalisiwe lwabanikazi bawo, futhi asetshenziswa ukuchaza lezo mkhiqizo kuphela. I-CadCraft ayihlobene futhi ayiphethwe, ayixhaswa noma ayamukelwa yoyiphi yazo.
connectai.title: Xhuma i-AI yakho
connectai.lead: Vumela i-AI osevele uyisebenzisa ukuthi isebenze nezinhlelo zakho ze-CadCraft. I-Studio ibonisa ngokucacile okuzoyengeza ezilungiselelweni zalolo hlelo le-AI futhi ikubhalele kuphela uma usuthi yebo. Akukho okuyimfihlo okungena ezilungiselelweni ze-AI.
connectai.will: Lokhu kwengeza into eyodwa egameni elithi cadcraft kuzilungiselelo zohlelo: {name} ({file}). Konke okunye kuzo kuhlala njengoba kunjalo, futhi kugcinwa ikhophi lokusekela enedethi.
connectai.disconnected.all: I-CadCraft isuswe kuzo zonke izinhlelo ze-AI.
connectai.unavailable: I-Studio ayikwazanga ukufuna izinhlelo ze-AI kule khompyutha.
connectai.copyfailed: Akukwazanga ukukopisha. Khetha umbhalo bese ukopisha kunalokho.
connectai.test: Qinisekisa ukuthi isebenza: namathisela lokhu kuhlelo lwakho lwe-AI
connectai.step.apps: Okungenani uhlelo olulodwa lwamukela abasizi (Izilungiselelo › Abasizi kuhlelo)
connectai.noclients: Akukho uhlelo lwe-AI olusebenzise i-CadCraft okwamanje.
hosted.title: Isixhumi esiphethwe ngu-CadCraft
askkey.title: Imodeli yakho ye-AI
askkey.lead: Namathisela ukhiye we-API ohlinzeka imodeli, noma ukhombise i-Studio imodeli kule khompyutha, bese ibhokisi lokubuza kuzo zonke izinhlelo liphendula ngayo: akukho uhlelo lwe-AI oluhlukile. Ukhiye ugcinwa kwisitolo sezimvume salale khompyutha; i-Studio ingawusebenzisa kodwa ayikaze uwubonise futhi awuyi kuya ku-CadCraft.
askkey.provider.compatible: Omunye umhlinzeki, noma imodeli kule khompyutha
askkey.base.hint: Ikheli elihambisana ne-OpenAI. Imodeli kule khompyutha (127.0.0.1) ayidingi ukhiye.
askkey.local: Leli kheli lisekhompyutheni le: akudingeki ukhiye futhi akukho okukhokhelwayo.
askkey.noprice: Akwaziwa intengo yale modeli, ngakho umkhawulo wamathokheni ngowokuvimbela ukusebenza. Faka izintengo zomhlinzeki ukuze ubale nemali futhi.
askkey.note: Umbuzo umi ekhawulweni yokuqala ifinyelela, usho ukuthi yiliphi. Ukusetshenziswa kuhlala kule khompyutha.
hosted.lead: Vumela umhlinzeki we-AI ewebhulawuza (njengo-claude.ai noma i-ChatGPT) asebenzise i-Studio ngedilesi yakho ku-getcadcraft.com. I-Studio yenza uxhumo olulodwa oluphumayo; akukho okulalela kule khompyutha. Ukhetha ukuthi yingani okwenzayo, futhi Londoloza noKhipha kuyakubuza kuqala.
hosted.unavailable: Isixhumi esiphethwe asikavulwa. Izisizi ze-AI ezingenhla ziyasebenza njengakuqala.
hosted.staffoff: Isixhumi esiphethwe sivalwe kule akhawunti yi-CadCraft.
hosted.notallowed: Isixhumi esiphethwe asitholakali kule akhawunti okwamanje.
hosted.state.on: Ivuliwe. Umhlinzeki we-AI angafinyelela i-Studio uma i-Studio ivuliwe.
hosted.level.suggest: Phakamisa: phakamisa izinguquko oyamukelayo noma oyenqabayo
hosted.ask: Ngibuze ngaphambi kokuthi umhlinzeki we-AI alondoloze noma akhiphe, kanye ngeseshini ngayinye
hosted.rotated: Ikheli lakho lishintshiwe. Abahlinzeki abasebenzisa elidala banqanyuliwe.
window.machines.title: Imishini
window.machines.lead: Iziphrinta, imishini ye-CNC namalesa kunethiwekhi yakho. Umsebenzi ulayishelwa emshinini; iphrinta kuphela yiyo engaqalwa lapha, futhi kuphela uma usuqinisekisile ukuthi useduze kuyo.
window.machines.add.title: Engeza umshini
window.machines.add.public: Leli kheli alisekhaya lakho lenethiwekhi. Sebenzisa ikheli lomshini ekhaya noma emsebenzini, njengo-192.168.1.40 noma printer.local.
window.machines.add.bad: Lena akuyona imishini i-Studio ekwazi ukuxhumana nayo.
window.machines.name: Igama
window.machines.test.fail: Ayikwazanga ukufinyelelwa. Hlola ikheli, ukuthi ivuliwe, nokhiye.
window.machines.key.saved: Ukhiye ulondoloziwe kule khompyutha. Awukwazi ukubonakala futhi.
window.machines.safety: Umshini we-CNC, ilesa noma irobhothi akuze kuqale kusuka ku-Studio: ifayela liya emshinini bese uliqalela khona.
window.machines.send.title: Thumela emshinini
window.machines.send.none: Akukho mshini walolu hlobo olusethiwe. Engeza enye ku-Studio ngaphansi kwe-Imishini.
window.machines.send.nostart: Lolu hlobo lomshini alukaze luqalwe kusuka ku-Studio. Ifayela liyalayishwa; liqalise emshinini.
window.machines.err.name: Ifayela kudingeka libe negama le-G-code noma le-NC, njengo-part.gcode noma beam.nc1.
window.machines.err.network: Ayikwazanga ukufinyelela umshini. Ingabe ivuliwe futhi isekhaya kunethiwekhi le?
standards.title: Imithetho yenkampani
standards.lead: Bhala imithetho yenkampani yakho kanye, noma ulayishe ifayela. Yonke i-AI oyixhumayo iyayifunda: amagama wamaqoqo nawamafayela, amagama osebenzisa wona, nokuhlolwa okufanele umdwebo wedlule. Azikaze zimnike i-AI ukufinyelela okungaphezu kwalokho ovumele kona.
standards.will: Lena yimithetho yonke i-AI ezoyifunda ({firm}, uguquko {revision}, {updated}). Yifunde ngaphambi kokuyigcina, ikakhulu ifayela elivela komunye umuntu.
activity.title: Abasizi bakho bekwenzile ukuthini
activity.lead: Yonke i-AI oyixhumayo, ngamagama alulazayo: okufundile, okusebenzise nokushintshe, kunoma iyiphi iwindi. Khipha uhlu uma inkampani yakho idinga irekhodi. Thatha ushintsho emuva kuleyo nhlelo ngokuhlehlisa kwayo.
activity.none: Akukho lutho okwamanje. Lolu hlu luyagcwala uma umsizi esebenzisa uhlelo.
